Subject: Greenhouse renewal + Checkr transition — initial options

Team,

TL;DR: Greenhouse is up for renewal Oct 15. Checkr contract can be switched over next quarter. I pulled three options and a preferred recommendation — need a quick call this week to lock procurement ask. Attachments: GH_renewal_quote_Q4_2027.pdf, Checkr_scope_v2.pdf, training_pricing_summary.xlsx.

Options (high level):
1) Auto-renew (status quo) — no negotiation; estimated spend: $115k/year. Risk: lost leverage, no promotional credits.
2) 12-month renewal with 10% standard discount + 6-month pilot on new features (requires procurement negotiation). Estimated final: $103.5k + pilot fees.
3) Move to tiered user model + replace standard background check flow with Checkr pay-per-use for new hires — upfront transition costs ~ $12k, annual run-rate savings ~ $18k.

Other asks: pause Greenhouse auto-renew pending negotiations; request pro-rated license for overlap period if we migrate users mid-contract; request training credits from Learnio if we switch background checks to an API-first flow.

Please reply with your preference (1/2/3) and any deal-breakers by EOD Thursday. If you prefer, propose a 30-min sync and I’ll book.

Thanks,
Monica
